newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATLETICO HANG ON FOR 2-1 WIN OVER ESPANYOL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO HANG ON FOR 2-1 WIN OVER ESPANYOL.

text.p: Atletico Madrid boosted their morale ahead of next week's European Champions' League match against Steaua Bucharest with a 2-1 win over Espanyol on Saturday.
Atletico had struggled to break down the Espanyol defence before Jose Luis Caminero capitalised on a mistake just after the break. Santi Denia made it 2-0 shortly afterwards.
But Radomir Antic's side were made to suffer after Javi Garcia pulled one back for the visitors 10 minutes from the end.
They ended the game with 10 men when striker Kiko Narvaez picked up his second yellow card.
Atletico stay in sixth place, seven points behind leaders Barcelona who play Valladolid on Monday.
